comment.body:
Thanks for the exact New key steps and the restart/elevation checks. #51789 has merged for a known signer-verification cause of this banner, but the banner alone does not establish that cause on your PCs. The contribution in #51918 improves exception logging; it is not itself a pairing repair.

- Comment `/bugreport` immediately after one failed **New Key** attempt so we can identify the corresponding Settings/Mouse Without Borders rejection or exception.
- State whether **Use Service** is on and whether changing another Mouse Without Borders setting also fails.

Do not post the pairing/security key. There is no need to repeat the supplied version, restart checks or all-PC reproduction. Use the existing signer-fix route if the capture matches; otherwise this evidence will separate a different failure.
